claire: Quick repro: on canary the magnet-13b-q2_k pack shows KV drift when two prefill streams overlap by ~256 tokens during long-doc QA. Repro command: 
```
python tools/repro_overlap.py --model redwood-magnet-13b-q2_k --clients 2 --prefill 4096 --overlap 256 --max-tokens 8500
```
claire: Attached a trimmed log: 
```
[2026-02-18T22:10:12Z] s=A PREFILL done base=0 len=4096 kv_idx=4096 fp=0xabc12
[2026-02-18T22:10:12Z] s=B PREFILL done base=3840 len=4096 kv_idx=3837 fp=0xabbff
[2026-02-18T22:10:12Z] WARN kv_index_mismatch expected=4096 got=3837\n[2026-02-18T22:10:12Z] ERROR rope_anchor_shift token_pos=6121 phase_delta=3
```
sam: Single-client clean. Multi-client ~1/40 runs. If I disable rotary (runtime::rotary_skip=true) the mismatch disappears.
yusuf: sounds like quant packing (q2_k) amplifies tiny index skew into phase aliasing. Can you dump per-layer cos/sin residuals at token_pos ~6100?
claire: pushed trace to /staging/traces/6321009876/ and started a debug job. infra-bot: job 6321009876-debug started on canary-7 :white_check_mark:
mia: next steps: 1) try single-threaded interleaved clients to rule out allocator races 2) run high-precision rotary kernel on failing trace 3) add a small CI flaky test that runs repro 200x. If numeric diff confirms q2_k rotary math is root cause, we'll add FP fallback for layers with phase_delta>1 and hold rollout on Dedicated.
sam: I'll add a quick probe to print per-layer rotation scales and kv fingerprints during prefill completion.
claire: thanks team, opening a short issue and will attach failing traces + repro script.
